name: Inner 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A framework for direct volumetric inference that models continuous volumetric density using 3D Gaussians to reconstruct internal structures from sparse, pose-free sliced data, eliminating the need for camera poses.
summary: Inner 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs internal volumetric structures from sparse, pose-free sliced data by eliminating camera parameter requirements and using conditional splatting for dynamic slice adaptation.
